class.name: ros2_rviz_plugins/NavSinglePanel
class.description: Panel that sends goals to the /nav_single action (w_behavior_tree_interfaces/action/NavSingle). Subscribes to the goal pose published by NavSingleGoalTool and lets the user trigger / cancel the action with selected recovery_mode, pass_final_goal_tol, timeout_ms.

class.name: ros2_rviz_plugins/NavSingleGoalTool
class.description: Click tool that publishes the selected goal pose to a private topic (default /nav_single/goal_pose) for NavSinglePanel. Isolated from nav2 GoalTool and the 2D Goal Pose tool to avoid triggering other actions.
